title: Adali Cultural Center
description: Adali Cultural Center, A contemporary chalet-style hillside retreat combining exposed wood, stone bases, and panoramic glazed facades overlooking the landscape
notes: Adali Cultural Center is envisioned as a contemporary mountain-inspired retreat that blends regional character with modern form. The structure uses chalet-style pitched roofs, exposed wood, and stone masonry to root the architecture in the hillside terrain, while expansive glazed facades and layered terraces create visual openness and connection to the landscape. Set against a stepped stone plinth with vibrant floral edges, the building expresses warmth, craft, and cultural grounding—making it an inviting destination for art, community gatherings, and curated events in a naturally immersive setting
